theorem isRoot_iff_mathlib_isRoot {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (a : R) :
    IsRoot p a ↔ (toMathlibPolynomial p).IsRoot a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.mem_coefficientSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coefficientSupport_iff {R : Type*} [Zero R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ coefficientSupport p ↔ coefficient p n ≠ 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.polynomial_integralDomainAxioms
statement:
theorem polynomial_integralDomainAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) : IntegralDomainAxioms (PolynomialSequence R)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : Polynomial R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (fromMathlibPolynomial p) = p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_add
statement:
theorem toMathlib_add {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (p + q) = toMathlibPolynomial p + toMathlibPolynomial q

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_injective
statement:
theorem toMathlib_injective {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    Function.Injective (toMathlibPolynomial : PolynomialSequence R → Polynomial R)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_mul
statement:
theorem toMathlib_mul {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (p * q) = toMathlibPolynomial p * toMathlibPolynomial q

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_neg
statement:
theorem toMathlib_neg {R : Type*} [Ring R] (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (-p) = -toMathlibPolynomial p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_one
statement:
theorem toMathlib_one {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    toMathlibPolynomial (1 : PolynomialSequence R) = 1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_zero
statement:
theorem toMathlib_zero {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    toMathlibPolynomial (0 : PolynomialSequence R) = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.EuclideanDomainAxioms.division
statement:
theorem EuclideanDomainAxioms.division {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a = b * E.quotient a b + E.remainder a b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.EuclideanDomainAxioms.remainder_lt
statement:
theorem EuclideanDomainAxioms.remainder_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    E.measure (E.remainder a b) < E.measure b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanDomain_bezout_for_gcd
statement:
theorem euclideanDomain_bezout_for_gcd {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    ∃ s t : R, euclideanGCD E a b = s * a + t * b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor
statement:
theorem euclideanGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    GreatestCommonDivisor (euclideanGCD E a b) a b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_nonzero
statement:
theorem euclideanGCD_nonzero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    euclideanGCD E a b = euclideanGCD E b (E.remainder a b)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem euclideanGCD_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a : R) : euclideanGCD E a 0 = a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.extendedEuclidean_bezout
statement:
theorem extendedEuclidean_bezout {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    (extendedEuclidean E a b).1 =
      (extendedEuclidean E a b).2.1 * a +
      (extendedEuclidean E a b).2.2 * b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.extendedEuclidean_gcd
statement:
theorem extendedEuclidean_gcd {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    (extendedEuclidean E a b).1 = euclideanGCD E a b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlibPolynomialGCD_bezout
statement:
theorem mathlibPolynomialGCD_bezout {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (a b : Polynomial K) :
    ∃ s t : Polynomial K,
      euclideanGCD (mathlibPolynomialEuclideanDomainAxioms K) a b = s * a + t * b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlibPolynomialGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor
statement:
theorem mathlibPolynomialGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (a b : Polynomial K) :
    GreatestCommonDivisor
      (euclideanGCD (mathlibPolynomialEuclideanDomainAxioms K) a b) a b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_monic_division_identity
statement:
theorem mathlib_monic_division_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : Polynomial R) (_hd : d.Monic) :
    p = d * p.divByMonic d + p.modByMonic d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_monic_quotient_remainder_unique
statement:
theorem mathlib_monic_quotient_remainder_unique
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d q r : Polynomial R) (hd : d.Monic)
    (hidentity : p = d * q + r) (hdegree : r.degree < d.degree) :
    q = p.divByMonic d ∧ r = p.modByMonic d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_monic_remainder_degree_lt
statement:
theorem mathlib_monic_remainder_degree_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d : Polynomial R) (hd : d.Monic) :
    (p.modByMonic d).degree < d.degree

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem mathlib_monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dvd {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : Polynomial R) (hd : d.Monic) :
    p.modByMonic d = 0 ↔ d ∣ p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_polynomial_division_identity
statement:
theorem mathlib_polynomial_division_identity {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : Polynomial K) (_hd : d ≠ 0) :
    p = d * (p / d) + p % d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_polynomial_remainder_measure_lt
statement:
theorem mathlib_polynomial_remainder_measure_lt {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : Polynomial K) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure (p % d) < mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_division_identity
statement:
theorem monic_division_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (_hd : Monic d) :
    p = d * monicQuotient p d + monicRemainder p d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_iff_mathlib_monic
statement:
theorem monic_iff_mathlib_monic {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    Monic p ↔ (toMathlibPolynomial p).Monic

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_quotient_remainder_unique
statement:
theorem monic_quotient_remainder_unique {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d q r : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d)
    (hidentity : p = d * q + r) (hdegree : degree r < degree d) :
    q = monicQuotient p d ∧ r = monicRemainder p d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_remainder_degree_lt
statement:
theorem monic_remainder_degree_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d) :
    degree (monicRemainder p d) < degree d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dividesElement
statement:
theorem monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dividesElement {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d) :
    monicRemainder p d = 0 ↔ DividesElement d p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomialDegreeMeasure_eq_mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure
statement:
theorem polynomialDegreeMeasure_eq_mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (p : PolynomialSequence K) :
    polynomialDegreeMeasure p =
      mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure (toMathlibPolynomial p)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomialGCD_bezout
statement:
theorem polynomialGCD_bezout {K : Type*} [Field K]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomialGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomial_division_identity
statement:
theorem polynomial_division_identity {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) (_hd : d ≠ 0) :
    p = d * polynomialQuotient p d + polynomialRemainder p d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomial_remainder_measure_lt
statement:
theorem polynomial_remainder_measure_lt {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    polynomialDegreeMeasure (polynomialRemainder p d) < polynomialDegreeMeasure d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_monicQuotient
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_monicQuotient {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (monicQuotient p d) =
      (toMathlibPolynomial p).divByMonic (toMathlibPolynomial d)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_monicRemainder
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_monicRemainder {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (monicRemainder p d) =
      (toMathlibPolynomial p).modByMonic (toMathlibPolynomial d)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialQuotient
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialQuotient {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (polynomialQuotient p d) =
      toMathlibPolynomial p / toMathlibPolynomial d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialRemainder
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialRemainder {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (polynomialRemainder p d) =
      toMathlibPolynomial p % toMathlibPolynomial d

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.coefficient_derivative
statement:
theorem coefficient_derivative
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (p : Polynomial K) (n : ℕ) :
    p.derivative.coeff n = p.coeff (n + 1) * (n + 1 : K)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.derivative_mul
statement:
theorem derivative_mul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (p q : Polynomial K) :
    (p * q).derivative = p.derivative * q + p * q.derivative

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.derivative_rootMultiplicity
statement:
theorem derivative_rootMultiplicity
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {p : Polynomial K} {a : K} (ha : p.IsRoot a) :
    p.derivative.rootMultiplicity a = p.rootMultiplicity a - 1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_iteratedDerivative_isRoot
statement:
theorem lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_iteratedDerivative_isRoot
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} {n : ℕ} :
    n < p.rootMultiplicity a ↔
      ∀ m ≤ n, ((Polynomial.derivative)^[m] p).IsRoot a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.monic_irreducible_factorization_unique
statement:
theorem monic_irreducible_factorization_unique
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {s t : Multiset (Polynomial K)}
    (hsM : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Monic) (htM : ∀ q ∈ t, q.Monic)
    (hsI : ∀ q ∈ s, Irreducible q) (htI : ∀ q ∈ t, Irreducible q)
    (hprod : s.prod = t.prod) : s = t

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.normalizedFactor_monic_irreducible
statement:
theorem normalizedFactor_monic_irreducible
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    {p q : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ∈ normalizedFactors p) :
    q.Monic ∧ Irreducible q

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot_derivative
statement:
theorem one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot_derivative
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} :
    1 < p.rootMultiplicity a ↔ p.IsRoot a ∧ p.derivative.IsRoot a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.polynomial_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem polynomial_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_normalizedFactors
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (p : Polynomial K) :
    C p.leadingCoeff * (normalizedFactors p).prod = p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.polynomial_exists_irreducible_factorization
statement:
theorem polynomial_exists_irreducible_factorization
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ factors : Multiset (Polynomial K),
      (∀ q ∈ factors, Irreducible q) ∧ Associated factors.prod p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.polynomial_irreducible_factorization_unique
statement:
theorem polynomial_irreducible_factorization_unique
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {s t : Multiset (Polynomial K)}
    (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, Irreducible q) (ht : ∀ q ∈ t, Irreducible q)
    (hprod : Associated s.prod t.prod) :
    Multiset.Rel Associated s t

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.pow_X_sub_C_dvd_iff_le_rootMultiplicity
statement:
theorem pow_X_sub_C_dvd_iff_le_rootMultiplicity
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} {n : ℕ} :
    (X - C a) ^ n ∣ p ↔ n ≤ p.rootMultiplicity a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.repeatedRoot_iff_isRoot_derivative
statement:
theorem repeatedRoot_iff_isRoot_derivative
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} (ha : p.IsRoot a) :
    RepeatedRoot p a ↔ p.derivative.IsRoot a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (a : K) (n : ℕ) :
    rootMultiplicity a ((X - C a) ^ n) = n

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_iff
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} {n : ℕ} :
    p.rootMultiplicity a = n ↔
      (X - C a) ^ n ∣ p ∧ ¬(X - C a) ^ (n + 1) ∣ p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_one_iff
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} :
    p.rootMultiplicity a = 1 ↔ SimpleRoot p a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_mul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p q : Polynomial K} {a : K}
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (p * q).rootMultiplicity a = p.rootMultiplicity a + q.rootMultiplicity a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_pos_iff_isRoot
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_pos_iff_isRoot
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.roots_count_eq_rootMultiplicity
statement:
theorem roots_count_eq_rootMultiplicity
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (p : Polynomial K) (a : K) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.simpleRoot_iff_derivative_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simpleRoot_iff_derivative_eval_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.mem_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_iff
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictAutomorphism_apply
statement:
theorem restrictAutomorphism_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) (x : IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :
    ((restrictAutomorphism F σ hσ).forward x).val = σ.forward x.val

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictAutomorphism_comp_apply
statement:
theorem restrictAutomorphism_comp_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ τ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) (hτ : PreservesIntermediateField τ F)
    (x : IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :
    (restrictAutomorphism F (σ * τ)
      (comp_preservesIntermediateField F σ τ hσ hτ)).forward x =
        ((restrictAutomorphism F σ hσ) *
          (restrictAutomorphism F τ hτ)).forward x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictAutomorphism_identity_apply
statement:
theorem restrictAutomorphism_identity_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictAutomorphism_inverse_apply
statement:
theorem restrictAutomorphism_inverse_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) (x : IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :
    (restrictAutomorphism F σ⁻¹
      (inverse_preservesIntermediateField F σ hσ)).forward x =
        ((restrictAutomorphism F σ hσ)⁻¹).forward x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictEmbedding_apply

theorem restrictEmbedding_apply

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictEmbedding_comp_apply
statement:
theorem restrictEmbedding_comp_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ τ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) (hτ : PreservesIntermediateField τ F)
    (x : IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :
    restrictEmbedding F (σ * τ)
      (comp_preservesIntermediateField F σ τ hσ hτ) x =
        restrictEmbedding F σ hσ (restrictEmbedding F τ hτ x)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.restrictEmbedding_identity_apply

theorem restrictEmbedding_identity_apply

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.subgroupCorrespondence_symm_apply

theorem subgroupCorrespondence_symm_apply {G : Type*} [Group G]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.internalDirectProductEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem internalDirectProductEquiv_apply {G : Type*} [Group G]

    (hcomm : ∀ h : H, ∀ k : K, Commute (h : G) (k : G))
    (hcompl : H.IsComplement' K) (x : H × K) :
    internalDirectProductEquiv H K hcomm hcompl x = (x.1 : G) * (x.2 : G)

statement:
theorem internalSemidirectProductEquiv_apply {G : Type*} [Group G]

    (x : H ⋊[(H.normalizerMonoidHom).comp
      (Subgroup.inclusion (H.normalizer_eq_top ▸ le_top))] K) :
    internalSemidirectProductEquiv H K h x = (x.left : G) * (x.right : G)

statement:
theorem semidirectProduct_decomposition {N G : Type*} [Group N] [Group G]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.semidirectProduct_mul
statement:
theorem semidirectProduct_mul {N G : Type*} [Group N] [Group G]
    (φ : G →* MulAut N) (x y : N ⋊[φ] G) :
    x * y = ⟨x.left * φ x.right y.left, x.right * y.right⟩

theorem orbit_mem_iff {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x y : X) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.stabilizer_mem_iff

      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided) I) ↔ x ∈ I

    q ∈ idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealComap (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided) J) ↔ q ∈ J

@[simp] theorem localizationFraction_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b c d : R)
    (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) (hd : d ∈ S.carrier) :
    localizationFraction S a b hb + localizationFraction S c d hd =
      localizationFraction S (a * d + c * b) (b * d) (S.mul_mem hb hd)

    localizationFraction S a b hb = localizationFraction S c d hd ↔
      ∃ u : R, u ∈ S.carrier ∧ u * (a * d - c * b) = 0

statement:
theorem multivariable_taylor_integral_remainder {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {N : ℕ} {f : E → F} {x y : E}
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ (N + 1) f (x + t • y)) :
    f (x + y) = multivariableTaylorPolynomial N f x y +
      (Nat.factorial N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (1 - t) ^ N • iteratedFDeriv ℝ (N + 1) f (x + t • y) (fun _ ↦ y)

    {f : E₁ × E₂ → F} {u : E₁ × E₂}

    (h₂ : (fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂).IsInvertible) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.implicit_function_theorem
statement:
theorem implicit_function_theorem {E₁ E₂ F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : E₁ × E₂ → F} {u : E₁ × E₂}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f u)
    (h₂ : (fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ ψ : E₁ → E₂,
      ψ u.1 = u.2 ∧
      (∀ᶠ x in nhds u.1, f (x, ψ x) = f u) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ u.1 ∧
      HasFDerivAt ψ
        (-(fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂).inverse ∘L
          (fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E₁ E₂)) u.1

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.inverse_function_theorem
statement:
theorem inverse_function_theorem {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {a : E} {L : E ≃L[ℝ] F}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f a) (hL : HasFDerivAt f (L : E →L[ℝ] F) a) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph E F,
      (e : E → F) = f ∧ a ∈ e.source ∧ f a ∈ e.target ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 e.symm (f a) ∧
      HasFDerivAt e.symm (L.symm : F →L[ℝ] E) (f a)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.constant_rank_theorem_rudin_9_32
statement:
theorem constant_rank_theorem_rudin_9_32
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (hrank : ∀ x ∈ E, Module.finrank ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x).range = r)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = (fderiv ℝ F a).range) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      ∃ φ : (fderiv ℝ F a).range → P.ker,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ
          {y | (y : Euc m) ∈ (fderiv ℝ F a) '' e.target} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ e.target,
          F (e.symm x) = fderiv ℝ F a x +
            (φ ⟨fderiv ℝ F a x,
              LinearMap.mem_range_self
                (fderiv ℝ F a : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩ : Euc m)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_coordinate_change
statement:
lemma rudin_coordinate_change
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hA : HasFDerivAt F A a)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (S : A.range →L[ℝ] Euc n) (hS : ∀ y : A.range, A (S y) = y) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.source,
        e x = x + S ⟨P (F x - A x), by
          rw [← hPrange]
          exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) (F x - A x)⟩) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (F (e.symm x)) = A x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_coordinate_map
statement:
lemma rudin_coordinate_map
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hA : HasFDerivAt F A a)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (S : A.range →L[ℝ] Euc n) (hS : ∀ y : A.range, A (S y) = y) :
    ∃ G : Euc n → Euc n,
      (∀ x, G x = x + S ⟨P (F x - A x), by
        rw [← hPrange]
        exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) (F x - A x)⟩) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G E ∧
      HasFDerivAt G (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a ∧
      ∀ x ∈ E, A (G x) = P (F x)

statement:
theorem fubini [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] (f : α × β → E)

theorem exists_isGreatest_on_Icc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, f y ≤ f x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.exists_isLeast_on_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_isLeast_on_Icc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f y

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.hpt_theorem
SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.intermediate_value
statement:
theorem intermediate_value {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) {y : ℝ} (h : y ∈ Set.Icc (f a) (f b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = y

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.inverse_continuous
statement: theorem inverse_continuous {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) : Continuous (mono_inv hf)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_apply
statement:
lemma mono_inv_apply {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (y : ↑(Set.range f)) :
    f (mono_inv hf y) = y.val

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_lt_iff
statement:
lemma mono_inv_lt_iff {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (y1 y2 : ↑(Set.range f)) :
    mono_inv hf y1 < mono_inv hf y2 ↔ y1 < y2

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_strictMono
statement: lemma mono_inv_strictMono {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) : StrictMono (mono_inv hf)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_sub_apply
statement:
lemma mono_inv_sub_apply {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (t : ℝ) :
    mono_inv hf ⟨f t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ = t

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.uniformContinuousOnTextbook_iff_uniformContinuousOn
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousOnTextbook_iff_uniformContinuousOn {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} :
    UniformContinuousOnTextbook f s ↔ UniformContinuousOn f s

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.uniformContinuous_iff_eps_delta
statement:
theorem uniformContinuous_iff_eps_delta {f : ℝ → ℝ} :
    UniformContinuous f ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x y, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.C2_subinterval
statement:
lemma C2_subinterval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (huni : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hq : q ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hwidth : |p - q| < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    sSup (f '' Set.Icc p q) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc p q) ≤ 2 * ε

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.b3_osc
statement:
lemma b3_osc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : I.Nonempty)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hosc : ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, |f x - f y| ≤ ε) :
    sSup (f '' I) ≤ sInf (f '' I) + 2 * ε

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_indicator_integrable
statement:
theorem continuous_indicator_integrable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem continuous_intervalIntegrable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt
statement:
theorem continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) : RiemannIntegrable f a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.darboux_lower_le_interval
statement:
theorem darboux_lower_le_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1))
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    lowerSum f P ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.darboux_upper_ge_interval
statement:
theorem darboux_upper_ge_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1))
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤ upperSum f P

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.f_le_step_sup_pointwise
statement:
lemma f_le_step_sup_pointwise {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc p q)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc p q) :
    f t ≤ sSup (f '' Set.Icc p q)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.fin_strict_mono_le
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.indicator_f_le_indicator_uP
statement:
lemma indicator_f_le_indicator_uP {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ≤
      (Set.Ioc a b).indicator
        (fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
          (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) t

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integral_indicator_const_Ioc
statement:
theorem integral_indicator_const_Ioc {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c) x ∂volume) = c * (b - a)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integral_sum_indicator_Ioc
statement:
theorem integral_sum_indicator_Ioc {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i ≤ x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) ∂volume) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * (x (i+1) - x i)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.interval_le_sSup_lowerSum_add
statement:
theorem interval_le_sSup_lowerSum_add {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤
      sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} + ε

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.interval_width
statement:
lemma interval_width {p q x y : ℝ} (_hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc p q) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc p q) :
    |x - y| ≤ q - p

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.lower_sum_le_interval
statement:
theorem lower_sum_le_interval {f sP : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hsP : ∀ t, s.indicator sP t = sP t)
    (hf_mono : ∀ t, s.indicator sP t ≤ s.indicator f t)
    (hisP : Integrable (s.indicator sP) volume)
    (hif : Integrable (s.indicator f) volume) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) ≤ (∫ t : ℝ in s, f t ∂volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.mono_x_le
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.mono_x_le_le
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_cover
statement:
lemma partition_cover {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (x0 : x 0 = a) (xN : x n = b) (hx : ∀ i, i < n → x i < x (i+1))
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∃ i, i < n ∧ x i < t ∧ t ≤ x (i+1)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_disjoint
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_point_mem
statement:
lemma partition_point_mem {n i : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (x0 : x 0 = a) (xN : x n = b) (hx : ∀ k, k < n → x k < x (k+1))
    (hi : i ≤ n) :
    x i ∈ Set.Icc a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_subinterval_sub
statement:
lemma partition_subinterval_sub {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (_hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.restricted_integral_const_Ioc
statement:
theorem restricted_integral_const_Ioc {p q c : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc p q, c ∂volume) = c * (q - p)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_eq_interval
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_eq_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral f a b = (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_le_interval
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_le_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral f a b ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_eval_at
statement:
theorem step_eval_at {n i : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hi : i < n)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1)))
    (hdisj : ∀ j, j < n → j ≠ i → t ∉ Set.Ioc (x j) (x (j+1))) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
      (Set.Ioc (x j) (x (j+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c j) t) = c i

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_ge_f_upper
statement:
lemma step_ge_f_upper {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b,
      f t ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_indicator_identity
statement:
theorem step_indicator_identity {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator
        (fun u => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) u) t
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_integral_eq_lowerSum
statement:
lemma step_integral_eq_lowerSum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ∂volume) =
      lowerSum f P

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_le_f_pointwise
statement:
lemma step_le_f_pointwise {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc p q)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc p q) :
    sInf (f '' Set.Icc p q) ≤ f t

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_le_f_upper
statement:
lemma step_le_f_upper {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ≤ f t

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_sum
statement:
lemma step_sum {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (_hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) = b - a

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum
statement:
lemma step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ∂volume) =
      upperSum f P

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.uniformPartition_step
statement:
theorem uniformPartition_step {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n)
    (i : ℕ) (_hi : i < n) :
    (uniformPartition a b n hab hpos).x (i + 1) - (uniformPartition a b n hab hpos).x i =
      (b - a) / (n : ℝ)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.uniform_x_mem
statement:
lemma uniform_x_mem {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    a + (i : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.ae_continuity_exceptional_measurable_hull
statement:
theorem ae_continuity_exceptional_measurable_hull {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hc : AlmostEverywhereContinuousOn f a b) :
    ∃ N : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet N ∧
      ({x : ℝ | x ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧ ¬ ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Icc a b) x} ⊆ N) ∧
      volume N = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.ae_continuity_exceptional_set_null
statement:
theorem ae_continuity_exceptional_set_null {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hc : AlmostEverywhereContinuousOn f a b) :
    volume {x : ℝ | x ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧
      ¬ ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Icc a b) x} = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.ae_continuousOn_iff_ae_oscillationWithin_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ae_continuousOn_iff_ae_oscillationWithin_eq_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} :
    AlmostEverywhereContinuousOn f a b ↔
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b),
        oscillationWithin f (Set.Icc a b) x = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.ae_oscillationWithin_eq_zero_of_layers_null
statement:
theorem ae_oscillationWithin_eq_zero_of_layers_null {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : BoundedOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hzero : ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → volume (positiveOscillationLayer f a b ε) = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b),
      oscillationWithin f (Set.Icc a b) x = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.badIntervals_length_le_upper_sub_lower
statement:
theorem badIntervals_length_le_upper_sub_lower {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : BoundedOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (P : DarbouxPartition a b) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∑ i ∈ badPartitionIndices f P ε, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i)) * ε ≤
      upperSum f P - lowerSum f P

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.bad_interval_length_sum_bound
statement:
theorem bad_interval_length_sum_bound
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (U : Set ℝ)
    (hUmeasure : volume U < ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1))))
    {P : DarbouxPartition a b} (bad : Finset ℕ)
    (hbad : bad ⊆ Finset.range P.n)
    (hbadCover : ∀ i ∈ bad, Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ U) :
    (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * C)) < δ / 2

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.bad_intervals_length_arithmetic
statement:
theorem bad_intervals_length_arithmetic
    {a b C δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (U : Set ℝ) (hUmeasure : volume U < ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1))))
    {P : DarbouxPartition a b} (bad : Finset ℕ)
    (hbad : bad ⊆ Finset.range P.n)
    (hbadCover : ∀ i ∈ bad, Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ U) :
    (hmeasure : ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i)) <
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1)))) →
    (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * C)) < δ / 2

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.bad_intervals_length_le_volume
statement:
theorem bad_intervals_length_le_volume
    {a b : ℝ} {U : Set ℝ} {P : DarbouxPartition a b} (bad : Finset ℕ)
    (hbad : bad ⊆ Finset.range P.n)
    (hbadCover : ∀ i ∈ bad, Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ U) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i)) ≤ volume U

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.bad_oscillation_sum_le_twoC
statement:
theorem bad_oscillation_sum_le_twoC
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ C) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (bad : Finset ℕ) (hbad : bad ⊆ Finset.range P.n) :
    (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
      (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) -
        sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))))) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * C)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.boundedOn_ae_continuousOn_riemannIntegrableWithBound
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.boundedOn_image_isBounded
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.choose_exceptional_open_cover
statement:
theorem choose_exceptional_open_cover
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ C)
    (hc : AlmostEverywhereContinuousOn f a b) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧
      volume U < ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1))) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ∉ U →
        ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Icc a b) x)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.compact_uniform_continuity_control
statement:
theorem compact_uniform_continuity_control
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {K : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f K) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ ρ > 0, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |x - y| < ρ → |f x - f y| < η

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.darboux_partition_with_mesh_lt
statement:
theorem darboux_partition_with_mesh_lt
    {a b ρ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b,
      ∀ i < P.n, P.x (i + 1) - P.x i < ρ

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.finite_continuity_cover_off_open
statement:
theorem finite_continuity_cover_off_open
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (U : Set ℝ)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U)
    (hcont : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ∉ U →
      ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Icc a b) x) :
    ∃ s : Set ℝ, s.Finite ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ Set.Icc a b) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ∉ U →
        ∃ y ∈ s, x ∈ Set.Ioo (y - 1) (y + 1))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.finite_local_oscillation_cover
statement:
theorem finite_local_oscillation_cover
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b δ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (U : Set ℝ) (hUopen : IsOpen U)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ∉ U →
      ∃ V, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧
        ∀ y ∈ V ∩ Set.Icc a b, ∀ z ∈ V ∩ Set.Icc a b,

      s.Finite ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, IsOpen (V y) ∧ (y : ℝ) ∈ V y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ u ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b, ∀ v ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b,
        |f u - f v| < δ / (2 * (b - a + 1))) ∧

statement:

    {P : DarbouxPartition a b} (i : ℕ) (hi : i < P.n)
    (s : Set {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U})
    (V : {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U} → Set ℝ)
    (hosc : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ u ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b, ∀ v ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b,
      |f u - f v| < δ / (2 * (b - a + 1)))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.good_interval_oscillation_sum_bound

    (hgood : good ⊆ Finset.range P.n)
    (U : Set ℝ) (s : Set {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U})

      Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ V y) :

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.interval_classification_and_bounds
statement:
theorem interval_classification_and_bounds
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C δ ρ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (U : Set ℝ) (hUmeasure : volume U < ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1))))
    (s : Set {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U})
    (V : {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U} → Set ℝ)
    (hosc : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ u ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b, ∀ v ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b,
      |f u - f v| < δ / (2 * (b - a + 1)))
    (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hbad : ∀ i < P.n, (Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ U) ∨
      ∃ y ∈ s, Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ V y)
    (hmesh : ∀ i < P.n, P.x (i + 1) - P.x i < ρ) :
    ∃ bad good : Finset ℕ,
      bad ⊆ Finset.range P.n ∧ good ⊆ Finset.range P.n ∧
      Disjoint bad good ∧ bad ∪ good = Finset.range P.n ∧
      (∑ i ∈ bad, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * C)) < δ / 2 ∧
      (∑ i ∈ good, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
        (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) -
          sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))))) < δ / 2

    (hgoodSum : (∑ i ∈ good, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
      (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) -
        sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))))) < δ / 2) :
    upperSum f P - lowerSum f P < δ

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_gap_sum_from_interval_classification
statement:
theorem partition_gap_sum_from_interval_classification
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b C δ ρ : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (U : Set ℝ) (hUmeasure : volume U < ENNReal.ofReal (δ / (4 * (C + 1))))
    (s : Set {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U})
    (V : {x // x ∈ Set.Icc a b \ U} → Set ℝ)
    (hosc : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ u ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b, ∀ v ∈ V y ∩ Set.Icc a b,
      |f u - f v| < δ / (2 * (b - a + 1)))
    (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hbad : ∀ i < P.n, (Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ U) ∨
      ∃ y ∈ s, Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)) ⊆ V y)
    (hmesh : ∀ i < P.n, P.x (i + 1) - P.x i < ρ) :
    upperSum f P - lowerSum f P < δ

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul {a b : ℝ}
    {u v u' v' : ℝ → ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a b)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Set.Icc a b))
    (hu' : ContinuousOn u' (Set.Icc a b)) (hv' : ContinuousOn v' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hdu : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hdv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt v (v' x) x) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => u x * v' x) a b =
      u b * v b - u a * v a - riemannIntegral (fun x => u' x * v x) a b

theorem riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hs : IsJordanMeasurable (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper))
    (I : RiemannBox 2) (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)

statement:
theorem riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlower : Measurable lower) (hupper : Measurable upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x)
    (hsection : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (Icc (lower x) (upper x)))
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (I : RiemannBox 2)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ v ∈ Box.Icc I,
      ‖(xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w)) v‖ ≤ C)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, ContinuousAt
      ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w))) v)
    (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)

statement:

    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hs : IsJordanMeasurable (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper))
    (houter : ContinuousOn
      (fun x ↦ riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)) (Icc a b))
    (I : RiemannBox 2) (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      riemannIntegral
        (fun x ↦ riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)) a b

      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) (volume.prod volume)) :
    (∫ z, f z) =
      ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π,

theorem integral_space_eq_iterated_cylindrical (f : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable f ((volume.prod volume).prod volume))
    (hcyl : IntegrableOn (fun p ↦ p.1.1 * f (cylindricalMap p))
      ((Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
      ((volume.prod volume).prod volume)) :
    (∫ q, f q ∂((volume.prod volume).prod volume)) =
      ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, ∫ z : ℝ,
        r * f ((r * cos θ, r * sin θ), z)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_space_eq_iterated_spherical
statement:
theorem integral_space_eq_iterated_spherical (f : Euclidean3 → ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦
        p.1 ^ 2 * sin p.2.2 * f (sphericalMap (sphericalParamsEquiv p)))
      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioo (-π) π ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) π))
      (volume.prod (volume.prod volume))) :
    (∫ x, f x) =
      ∫ ρ in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, ∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π,
        ρ ^ 2 * sin φ * f ![ρ * sin φ * cos θ,
          ρ * sin φ * sin θ, ρ * cos φ]

theorem integral_space_eq_spherical (f : Euclidean3 → ℝ) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exteriorDerivative_add
statement:
theorem exteriorDerivative_add {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} {ω η : DifferentialForm E k} {x : E}
    (hω : DifferentiableAt ℝ ω x) (hη : DifferentiableAt ℝ η x) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exteriorDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem exteriorDerivative_apply {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} {ω : DifferentialForm E k} {x : E} (hω : DifferentiableAt ℝ ω x)
    (v : Fin (k + 1) → E) :
    exteriorDerivative ω x v =
      ∑ i, (-1) ^ i.val • fderiv ℝ (ω · (i.removeNth v)) x (v i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exteriorDerivative_pullback

theorem exteriorDerivative_pullback {E : Type u} {F : Type v}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

    {k : ℕ} {r : WithTop ℕ∞} (f : E → F) (ω : DifferentialForm F k) (x : E)
    (hω : DifferentiableAt ℝ ω (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ r f x)
    (hr : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ r) :
    exteriorDerivative (formPullback f ω) x =
      formPullback f (exteriorDerivative ω) x

statement:
theorem cauchy_schwarz_sq (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.holder
statement:
theorem holder (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p q : ℝ}
    (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, |f i * g i| ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) * (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ q) ^ (1 / q)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.minkowski
statement:
theorem minkowski (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |f i + g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) +
        (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.young
statement:
theorem young (a b : ℝ) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ |a| ^ p / p + |b| ^ q / q

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₁_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₁_comp_reparam
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ)

    surfaceTangent₁ (σ ∘ φ) p =

      (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ))
    (hFcont : ContinuousOn F (Icc a b))
    (hFderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ Ioo (a i) (b i)),
      HasFDerivAt F (F' x) x)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.gauss_finite_decomposition
statement:
theorem gauss_finite_decomposition
    {ι : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι)
    (cell : ι → Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (divDensity : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (localFlux : ι → ℝ) (externalFlux : ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GaussFiniteDecomposition pieces cell divDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces, localFlux i = ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x)
    (hcancel : externalFlux = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localFlux i) :
    externalFlux = ∫ x in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, divDensity x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.gauss_finite_decomposition_of_face_incidence
statement:
theorem gauss_finite_decomposition_of_face_incidence
    {ι φ : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (faces : Finset φ)
    (cell : ι → Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (divDensity : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → φ → ℤ) (externalIncidence : φ → ℤ)
    (faceFlux : φ → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GaussFiniteDecomposition pieces cell divDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue faces (localIncidence i) faceFlux =
        ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x)
    (hincidence : ∀ f ∈ faces,
      externalIncidence f = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i f) :
    orientedBoundaryValue faces externalIncidence faceFlux =
      ∫ x in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, divDensity x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_binormal_domain
statement:
theorem green_binormal_domain
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (lower upper left right : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hleft : Continuous left) (hright : Continuous right)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x ≤ upper x)
    (hlr : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d, left y ≤ right y)
    (hdomains : xNormalDomain a b lower upper =
      yNormalDomain c d left right)
    (hPy : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hQx : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      (yNormalDomain c d left right) (volume.prod volume))
    (hPdiff : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (lower x) (upper x),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y)
    (hQdiff : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d, ∀ x ∈ Icc (left y) (right y),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x)
    (hPint : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun y ↦ P (x, y))) volume (lower x) (upper x))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, y))) volume (left y) (right y)) :
    normalDomainBoundaryIntegral P Q a b c d lower upper left right =
      ∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper,
        (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 -
          deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2) ∂(volume.prod volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_finite_decomposition
statement:
theorem green_finite_decomposition
    {ι : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι)
    (cell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (curlDensity : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localBoundary : ι → ℝ) (externalBoundary : ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GreenFiniteDecomposition pieces cell curlDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces, localBoundary i =
      ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hcancel : externalBoundary = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localBoundary i) :
    externalBoundary =
      ∫ z in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_finite_decomposition_of_edge_incidence
statement:
theorem green_finite_decomposition_of_edge_incidence
    {ι ε : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (cell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (curlDensity : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GreenFiniteDecomposition pieces cell curlDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i e) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      ∫ z in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_rectangle
statement:
theorem green_rectangle
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn P ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn Q ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂), HasFDerivAt P (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂), HasFDerivAt Q (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]])) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ x in a₁..b₁, ∫ y in a₂..b₂,
        Q' (x, y) (1, 0) - P' (x, y) (0, 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_split_horizontal

theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_split_horizontal
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b d c e : ℝ)
    (hQdc : IntervalIntegrable (fun y ↦ Q (b, y)) volume d c)
    (hQce : IntervalIntegrable (fun y ↦ Q (b, y)) volume c e)
    (hQdc' : IntervalIntegrable (fun y ↦ Q (a, y)) volume d c)
    (hQce' : IntervalIntegrable (fun y ↦ Q (a, y)) volume c e) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q a d b e =

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_split_vertical

theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_split_vertical
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a c b d e : ℝ)

    (hPcb : IntervalIntegrable (fun x ↦ P (x, d)) volume c b)
    (hPac' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x ↦ P (x, e)) volume a c)
    (hPcb' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x ↦ P (x, e)) volume c b) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q a d b e =
      rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q a d c e +

theorem stokes_closed_finite_atlas

      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ patches, localIncidence i e)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_parametrized_rectangle
statement:
theorem stokes_parametrized_rectangle
    (A : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ) (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]])) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
        (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ u in a₁..b₁, ∫ v in a₂..b₂,
        Q' (u, v) (1, 0) - P' (u, v) (0, 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_parametrized_rectangle_curl
statement:
theorem stokes_parametrized_rectangle_curl
    (A : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (J : ℝ × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ) (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hcurl : ∀ z, Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1) =
      curlMatrix3 (J z) ⬝ᵥ
        (surfaceTangent₁ σ z ⨯₃ surfaceTangent₂ σ z)) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
        (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ u in a₁..b₁, ∫ v in a₂..b₂,
        curlMatrix3 (J (u, v)) ⬝ᵥ
          (surfaceTangent₁ σ (u, v) ⨯₃ surfaceTangent₂ σ (u, v))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.cauchy_mvt

theorem cauchy_mvt {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.taylor_lagrange_remainder
statement:
theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) f (Set.uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.uIcc x₀ x)) (Set.uIoo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ Set.uIoo x₀ x,
      f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
        iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc x₀ x) x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / ↑(n + 1).factorial

    (h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)

statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_expansion {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ} {D : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    {c : JordanEuc n} (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ D volume)
    (h2 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)
    (h1 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => x i * ρ x) D) :
    momentOfInertia ρ D c =
      ∑ i, (secondMoment ρ D i - 2 * (c i) * firstMoment ρ D i
        + (c i) ^ 2 * mass ρ D)

statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_parallel_axis {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ}
    {D : Set (JordanEuc n)} {c : JordanEuc n} (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ D volume)
    (h2 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)
    (h1 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => x i * ρ x) D) :
    momentOfInertia ρ D c =
      (∑ i, secondMoment ρ D i) - 2 * (∑ i, c i * firstMoment ρ D i)
        + euclideanNormSq c * mass ρ D

theorem gauss_piecewiseSmoothRegion
    {ι φ : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (faces : Finset φ)
    (cell : ι → Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (divDensity : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → φ → ℤ) (externalIncidence : φ → ℤ)
    (faceFlux : φ → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GaussFiniteDecomposition pieces cell divDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue faces (localIncidence i) faceFlux =
        ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x)
    (hincidence : ∀ f ∈ faces, externalIncidence f = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i f) :
    orientedBoundaryValue faces externalIncidence faceFlux =
      ∫ x in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, divDensity x

    {ι ε : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (cell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (pulledBackDensity : ι → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (curlDensity : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hregion : PiecewiseSmoothRegion pieces edges cell pulledBackDensity
      localIncidence externalIncidence)
    (hdensity : ∀ i, pulledBackDensity i = curlDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      ∫ z in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)

    (parameterDomain : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (pulledBackDensity : ι → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hregion : PiecewiseSmoothRegion patches edges parameterDomain pulledBackDensity
      localIncidence externalIncidence)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ patches,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterDomain i, pulledBackDensity i p ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hclosed : ∀ e ∈ edges, externalIncidence e = 0) :
    finiteAtlasSurfaceIntegral patches parameterDomain pulledBackDensity = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.stokes_twoPatch_sharedEdge
statement:
theorem stokes_twoPatch_sharedEdge
    {ε : Type*} (edges : Finset ε)
    (parameterDomain : Fin 2 → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (pulledBackDensity : Fin 2 → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : Fin 2 → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) (shared : ε)
    (hshared_mem : shared ∈ edges)
    (hshared : localIncidence 0 shared + localIncidence 1 shared = 0)
    (hregion : PiecewiseSmoothRegion Finset.univ edges parameterDomain
      pulledBackDensity localIncidence externalIncidence)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterDomain i, pulledBackDensity i p ∂(volume.prod volume)) :
    (orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      (∫ p in parameterDomain 0, pulledBackDensity 0 p ∂(volume.prod volume)) +
        ∫ p in parameterDomain 1, pulledBackDensity 1 p ∂(volume.prod volume)) ∧
      externalIncidence shared = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.twoPatch_sharedEdge_cancellation
statement:
theorem twoPatch_sharedEdge_cancellation
    {ε : Type*} [DecidableEq ε] (edges : Finset ε) (localIncidence : Fin 2 → ε → ℤ)
    (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ) (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) (shared : ε)
    (hshared_mem : shared ∈ edges)
    (hshared : localIncidence 0 shared + localIncidence 1 shared = 0)
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges, externalIncidence e = localIncidence 0 e + localIncidence 1 e) :
    externalIncidence shared = 0 ∧
      orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
        orientedBoundaryValue (edges.erase shared) externalIncidence edgeIntegral

    [Module R M] [Module R N] (F : M →ₗ[R] N) : F 0 = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_mem_ker_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_mem_ker_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (F : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker F ↔ F x = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_mem_range_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (F : M →ₗ[R] N) (y : N) :
    y ∈ LinearMap.range F ↔ ∃ x, F x = y

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.module_axioms
statement:
theorem module_axioms {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (r s : R) (x y : M) :
    r • (x + y) = r • x + r • y ∧ (r + s) • x = r • x + s • x ∧
      (r * s) • x = r • (s • x) ∧ (1 : R) • x = x ∧ (0 : R) • x = 0 ∧ r • (0 : M) = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_closure
statement:
theorem submodule_closure {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S : Submodule R M) :
    (0 : M) ∈ S ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x + y ∈ S) ∧ (∀ (a : R) (x : M), x ∈ S → a • x ∈ S)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_eq_iff
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} : S = T ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ T

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_of_closure
statement:
theorem submodule_of_closure {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s : Set M} (h0 : (0 : M) ∈ s) (hadd : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x + y ∈ s)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : R) (x : M), x ∈ s → a • x ∈ s) :
    ∃ S : Submodule R M, (S : Set M) = s

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_submodule_self
statement:
theorem twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_submodule_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Set R) :

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.add_eq_add_iff_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem add_eq_add_iff_of_disjoint {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p q : Submodule R M} (h : Disjoint p q) {y y' : p} {z z' : q} :
    (y : M) + (z : M) = (y' : M) + (z' : M) ↔ y = y' ∧ z = z'

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.decomposition_unique_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem decomposition_unique_of_disjoint {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_existsUnique_toModule

theorem directSum_existsUnique_toModule {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃! g : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] N, ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), g (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_lof_ext_iff
statement:
theorem directSum_lof_ext_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) (g : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] N) :
    g = DirectSum.toModule R ι N φ ↔ ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), g (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_of_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem directSum_of_apply_of_ne {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_of_apply_same
statement:
theorem directSum_of_apply_same {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)] (i : ι) (x : M i) :

theorem directSum_toModule_lof {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_toModule_unique
statement:
theorem directSum_toModule_unique {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.internalDirectSum_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_lof

theorem internalDirectSum_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_lof {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*}

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_eq_iff_subset_and_le

theorem span_eq_iff_subset_and_le {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

theorem span_eq_of_submodule {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_univ

theorem span_univ {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_liftQ_mk

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_mk_smul

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.factor_ker

    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma delta : Path a b) (n : ℕ)
    (hgammaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (gamma.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (hdeltaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (delta.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (bottom top left right : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ)
    (hbottom : ∀ i, bottom i = 0) (htop : ∀ i, top i = 0)
    (hleft : ∀ i, left i = pathIntegral f
      (gamma.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (hright : ∀ i, right i = pathIntegral f
      (delta.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (houter : (∑ i, (bottom i - top i)) + ∑ i, (right i - left i) = 0) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.continuous_iff_preimage_closed
statement:
theorem continuous_iff_preimage_closed [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) :
    _root_.Continuous f ↔
      ∀ s : Set Y, _root_.IsClosed s → _root_.IsClosed (f ⁻¹' s)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.continuous_iff_preimage_open
statement:
theorem continuous_iff_preimage_open [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) :
    _root_.Continuous f ↔ ∀ u : Set Y, _root_.IsOpen u → _root_.IsOpen (f ⁻¹' u)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.mem_nhds_iff_exists_open

theorem mem_nhds_iff_exists_open [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) (s : Set X) :
    s ∈ 𝓝 x ↔ ∃ u : Set X, _root_.IsOpen u ∧ x ∈ u ∧ u ⊆ s

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_homeomorph_iff_exists_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_homeomorph_iff_exists_equiv [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] :
    Nonempty (X ≃ₜ Y) ↔
      ∃ e : X ≃ Y, _root_.Continuous (e : X → Y) ∧
        _root_.Continuous (e.symm : Y → X)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.topologicalSpace_open_axioms
statement:
theorem topologicalSpace_open_axioms [TopologicalSpace X] :
    IsOpen (Set.univ : Set X) ∧
      (∀ s t : Set X, IsOpen s → IsOpen t → IsOpen (s ∩ t)) ∧
      ∀ S : Set (Set X), (∀ s ∈ S, IsOpen s) → IsOpen (⋃₀ S)

theorem isOpen_prod_iff_rectangles [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

    Continuous unitInterval τX f ↔

        ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : UnitInterval, |u.1 - t.1| < ε → f u ∈ v

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.path_trans_apply_of_le

theorem path_trans_apply_of_le [TopologicalSpace X] {x y z : X}

    (h : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_pathHomotopy_iff_exists_fixed_endpoint_deformation
statement:
theorem nonempty_pathHomotopy_iff_exists_fixed_endpoint_deformation :
    Nonempty (p.Homotopy q) ↔
      ∃ F : unitInterval × unitInterval → X, Continuous F ∧
        (∀ s, F (0, s) = p s) ∧
        (∀ s, F (1, s) = q s) ∧
        (∀ t, F (t, 0) = x) ∧
        (∀ t, F (t, 1) = y)

    H.trans K z = H (⟨2 * z.1, by constructor <;> linarith [z.1.2.1, z.1.2.2]⟩, z.2)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.finiteRawOpenPathGrid_outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteRawOpenPathGrid_outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (R : FiniteRawOpenPathGrid ℂ)
    (hexact : ∀ i j, Complex.IsExactOn f (R.cellSet i j)) :
    (∑ i : Fin R.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (R.horizontalRaw i 0) -
          pathIntegral f (R.horizontalRaw i (Fin.last R.steps)))) +
      ∑ j : Fin R.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (R.verticalRaw (Fin.last R.steps) j) -
          pathIntegral f (R.verticalRaw 0 j)) = 0

      ∃ label : Fin (2 ^ n) → Fin (2 ^ n) → ι,

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b)
    (hmem : MapsTo gamma.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hdiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ gamma.extend t)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = g b - g a

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_homotopyInvariant_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_homotopyInvariant_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma delta : Path a b}
    (_homotopy : (gamma : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ℂ)).Homotopy delta)
    (hgammaMem : MapsTo gamma.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hdeltaMem : MapsTo delta.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hgammaDiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ gamma.extend t)
    (hdeltaDiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ delta.extend t)
    (hgammaInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hdeltaInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv delta.extend t * f (delta.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta

theorem green_standardRightTriangle
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hPy : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      standardRightTriangle (volume.prod volume))
    (hQx : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      standardRightTriangle (volume.prod volume))
    (hPdiff : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 (1 - x),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y)
    (hQdiff : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 (1 - y),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x)
    (hPint : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun y ↦ P (x, y))) volume 0 (1 - x))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, y))) volume 0 (1 - y)) :
    standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral P Q =
      ∫ z in standardRightTriangle,
        (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 -
          deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2) ∂(volume.prod volume)

        (-√(1 - x ^ 2)) (√(1 - x ^ 2)))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,

    unitDiskBoundaryIntegral P Q =

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily
statement:
theorem nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V),
      IsJordanBasisFamily N r (fun _ => 0) length b

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_operator_has_jordan_matrix
statement:
theorem nilpotent_operator_has_jordan_matrix [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
      (hb : IsJordanBasisFamily N r (fun _ => 0) length b),
      operatorMatrix (fun p : Σ i : Fin r, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2)
          hb.1 N = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => jordanBlock 0 (length i))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan
statement:
theorem operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : ι → K) (length : ι → ℕ)
    (b : (i : ι) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
    (hb : IsBasis K (fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ i, IsJordanChain T (μ i) (b i)) :
    operatorMatrix (fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2) hb.1 T =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => jordanBlock (μ i) (length i))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.exists_jordan_normal_basis

theorem exists_jordan_normal_basis [IsAlgClosed K] [IsFiniteDimensional K V]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.complex_matrix_is_similar_to_jordan

theorem complex_matrix_is_similar_to_jordan {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ (d : JordanFormData ℂ)
      (e : (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) ≃ Fin n),
      MatricesAreSimilar A (Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.matrix_is_similar_to_jordan

theorem matrix_is_similar_to_jordan [IsAlgClosed K] {n : ℕ}

      MatricesAreSimilar A (Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockDiagonal_toLin_apply
statement:
theorem blockDiagonal_toLin_apply
    [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {n : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (n i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (n i)]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (n i) (n i) K)
    (x : (Σ i, n i) → K) (i : ι) (j : n i) :
    Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A) x ⟨i, j⟩ =
      Matrix.toLin' (A i) (fun q => x ⟨i, q⟩) j

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockMultiplicity_eq_of_tailCount_eq

theorem blockMultiplicity_eq_of_tailCount_eq
    (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)

    ∀ μ m, d₁.blockMultiplicity μ m = d₂.blockMultiplicity μ m

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub
statement:
theorem blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d : JordanFormData K)
    (hd : HasJordanNormalBasis T d) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    d.blockTailCount μ k =
      generalizedKernelDimension T μ (k + 1) -
        generalizedKernelDimension T μ k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ
statement:
theorem blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ
    (d : JordanFormData K) (μ : K) (m : ℕ) :
    d.blockTailCount μ m =
      d.blockMultiplicity μ m + d.blockTailCount μ (m + 1)

theorem blockTailCount_eq_of_hasJordanNormalBasis

    (h₁ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₁)
    (h₂ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₂) :
    ∀ μ k, d₁.blockTailCount μ k = d₂.blockTailCount μ k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile
statement:
theorem generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
