    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d : JordanFormData K)
    (hd : HasJordanNormalBasis T d) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    generalizedKernelDimension T μ k = d.kernelProfile μ k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedKernelDimension_eq_matrix
statement:
theorem generalizedKernelDimension_eq_matrix
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (b : ι → V) (hb : IsBasis K b)
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    generalizedKernelDimension T μ k =
      matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension (operatorMatrix b hb T) μ k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_apply
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_apply
    [Field K] (μ : K) (m k : ℕ) (i j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ((jordanBlock μ m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) i j =
      if i.val + k = j.val then 1 else 0

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_rank
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_rank
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (μ : K) (m k : ℕ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock μ m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      (m + 1) - min k (m + 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (lam μ : K) (m k : ℕ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock lam m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      if lam = μ then (m + 1) - min k (m + 1) else m + 1

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank_of_ne
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank_of_ne
    [Field K] (lam μ : K) (m k : ℕ) (h : lam ≠ μ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock lam m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      m + 1

statement:
theorem jordanFormData_equivalent_of_fiber_card_eq
    (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
    (h : ∀ c : K × ℕ,

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanNormalMatrix_generalizedKernelDimension
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_generalizedKernelDimension
    [Field K] (d : JordanFormData K) [Fintype d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block]
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension (jordanNormalMatrix d) μ k =

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanNormalMatrix_shift_pow_eq_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_shift_pow_eq_blockDiagonal
    [Field K] (d : JordanFormData K) [Fintype d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block]
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    (jordanNormalMatrix d -
        Matrix.scalar (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) ^ k =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i =>
        (jordanBlock (d.eigenvalue i) (d.length i) -
          Matrix.scalar (Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) ^ k)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.leadingPrincipal_schur
statement:
theorem leadingPrincipal_schur {n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    leadingPrincipal
        (trailingBlock A - bottomLeftBlock A * (leadingBlock A)⁻¹ * topRightBlock A) hk =
      leadingPrincipal (trailingBlock A) hk -
        leadingBottomLeft A hk * (leadingBlock A)⁻¹ * leadingTopRight A hk

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.leadingPrincipal_succ_blocks

theorem leadingPrincipal_succ_blocks {n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (leadingPrincipal A (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)).submatrix
        (headTailEquiv k) (headTailEquiv k) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (leadingBlock A) (leadingTopRight A hk)
        (leadingBottomLeft A hk) (leadingPrincipal (trailingBlock A) hk)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.leadingPrincipal_succ_det
statement:
theorem leadingPrincipal_succ_det {n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hk : k ≤ n)
    (ha : A 0 0 ≠ 0) :
    (leadingPrincipal A (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)).det =
      A 0 0 *
        (leadingPrincipal
          (trailingBlock A - bottomLeftBlock A * (leadingBlock A)⁻¹ * topRightBlock A)
          hk).det

statement:
theorem lu_block_equations {n : ℕ}
    (L₁ U₁ L₂ U₂ : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K)
    (hL₁ : L₁.IsLowerTriangular) (hL₂ : L₂.IsLowerTriangular)
    (hU₁ : U₁.IsUpperTriangular) (hU₂ : U₂.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hdL₁ : ∀ i, L₁ i i = 1) (hdL₂ : ∀ i, L₂ i i = 1)
    (hprod : L₁ * U₁ = L₂ * U₂) :
    leadingBlock U₁ = leadingBlock U₂ ∧
      topRightBlock U₁ = topRightBlock U₂ ∧
      bottomLeftBlock L₁ * leadingBlock U₁ =
        bottomLeftBlock L₂ * leadingBlock U₂ ∧
      bottomLeftBlock L₁ * topRightBlock U₁ +
          trailingBlock L₁ * trailingBlock U₁ =
        bottomLeftBlock L₂ * topRightBlock U₂ +
          trailingBlock L₂ * trailingBlock U₂

statement:
theorem pivotPermutation_isUnit_det {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hA : IsUnit A.det)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsUnit (((Equiv.swap 0 i).permMatrix K * A).det)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pivotStep_schur_isUnit
statement:
theorem pivotStep_schur_isUnit {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hA : IsUnit A.det) :
    ∃ i : Fin (n + 1),
      let S := (Equiv.swap 0 i).permMatrix K * A
      let A₁₁ := leadingBlock S
      A i 0 ≠ 0 ∧ IsUnit A₁₁.det ∧
        IsUnit (trailingBlock S - bottomLeftBlock S * A₁₁⁻¹ * topRightBlock S).det

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.reassembleBlocks
statement:
theorem reassembleBlocks {n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv K K (headTailEquiv n)
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (leadingBlock S) (topRightBlock S)
          (bottomLeftBlock S) (trailingBlock S)) = S

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.recursive_block_product
statement:
theorem recursive_block_product {n : ℕ}
    (a : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) K) (B : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin n) K)
    (C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 1) K) (D P L U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    [Invertible a]
    (hrec : P * (D - C * ⅟a * B) = L * U) :
    liftTrailing P *
        Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv K K (headTailEquiv n) (Matrix.fromBlocks a B C D) =
      assembleLower (P * C * ⅟a) L * assembleUpper a B U

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.reindex_eq_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem reindex_eq_fromBlocks {n : ℕ}
    (S : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    S.submatrix (headTailEquiv n) (headTailEquiv n) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (leadingBlock S) (topRightBlock S)
        (bottomLeftBlock S) (trailingBlock S)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.schurComplement_isUnit_det
statement:
theorem schurComplement_isUnit_det {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix m m K) (B : Matrix m n K) (C : Matrix n m K) (D : Matrix n n K)
    [Invertible A] (hM : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det) :
    IsUnit (D - C * ⅟A * B).det

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.sum_fin_eq_sum_castLE
statement:
theorem sum_fin_eq_sum_castLE {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (f : Fin n → K)
    (hz : ∀ x : Fin n, k ≤ x.val → f x = 0) :
    ∑ x : Fin n, f x = ∑ x : Fin k, f (Fin.castLE hk x)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_ordered_jordan_similar
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_jordan_similar {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ (B P Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      B.IsUpperTriangular ∧ P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧ B = P * A * Q

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_real_invariant_pair
statement:
theorem exists_real_invariant_pair {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    ∃ (a b : ℝ) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) ∧
      A *ᵥ x = a • x - b • y ∧
      A *ᵥ y = b • x + a • y

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_upper_similar
statement:
theorem exists_upper_similar {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ (B P Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      B.IsUpperTriangular ∧ P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧ B = P * A * Q

statement:
theorem operatorMatrix_reindex_basis_schur
    {K V ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.LinearSpace K V]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (b : ι → V)
    (hb : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis K b)
    (hb' : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis K
      (fun k => b (e.symm k))) (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.SingularValueDecomposition.standardMatrix_eq_mul_singularDiagonal_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem SingularValueDecomposition.standardMatrix_eq_mul_singularDiagonal_mul_conjTranspose
    {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F} (d : SingularValueDecomposition T) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 E).toBasis
        (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 F).toBasis T =

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.polarPartialIsometry_apply_eq_rank_sum
statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_apply_eq_rank_sum (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)

    polarPartialIsometry T b x =
      ∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        (rightSingularBasis T).repr x
            (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i) •

      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :

statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E), finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val →
      (rightSingularBasis T).repr x i = 0) :
    ‖polarPartialIsometry T b x‖ = ‖x‖

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.rank_sum_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero
statement:
theorem rank_sum_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)

    (hx : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E), finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val →
      (rightSingularBasis T).repr x i = 0) :
    ‖∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        (rightSingularBasis T).repr x
            (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i) •

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.kernelProjection_apply_rightBasis
statement:
theorem kernelProjection_apply_rightBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i)
    (j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E)) :
    pseudoinverseWith T b (T (rightSingularBasis T j)) =
      if _h : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then rightSingularBasis T j else 0

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply
statement:
theorem orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
    {m r : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin m) 𝕜 G)
    (e : Fin r ↪ Fin m) (j : Fin m) :
    (∑ i : Fin r, InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (b (e i)) (b (e i))) (b j) =
      if _h : ∃ i, e i = j then b j else 0

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_eq_sum_rankOne (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (pseudoinverseWith T b).comp T =
      (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜
          (rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i))
          (rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE
            (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i))).toLinearMap

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_symmetric (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    ((pseudoinverseWith T b).comp T).IsSymmetric

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_penrose_one
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_penrose_one (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_penrose_two
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_penrose_two (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (pseudoinverseWith T b).comp (T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b)) =

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_eq_sum_rankOne (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b) =
      (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))
          (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))).toLinearMap

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_symmetric (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b)).IsSymmetric

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.rangeProjection_apply_leftBasis
statement:
theorem rangeProjection_apply_leftBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i)
    (j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) :
    T (pseudoinverseWith T b (b j)) =
      if _h : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then b j else 0

    positiveIndex Q = Set.ncard {i | 0 < w i} ∧
      negativeIndex Q = Set.ncard {i | w i < 0}

    (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) (hTb : ∀ i, T (b i) = μ i • b i) :
    operatorQuadraticForm T (∑ i, c i • b i) =
      ∑ i, μ i * (c i) ^ 2

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SpectralQuadratic.spectral_theorem
statement:
theorem spectral_theorem {n : ℕ} [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

    (hT : IsSelfAdjointOperator T) :
    ∃ (b : Fin n → E) (μ : Fin n → ℝ),
      IsBasis ℝ b ∧ Orthonormal ℝ b ∧
        ∀ i, T (b i) = μ i • b i

SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.abs_sub_convergent_le_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem abs_sub_convergent_le_of_decomposition (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ)
    {p q a b : ℤ}
    (hp : (p : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)
      + (b : ℝ) * (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (hq : (q : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ)
      + (b : ℝ) * (continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (hq0 : 0 < (q : ℝ))
    (hqlt : (q : ℝ) < (continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    |(continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)| ≤
      |(q : ℝ) * ξ - (p : ℝ)|

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primitivePythagorean_classification
statement:
theorem primitivePythagorean_classification {x y z : ℤ}
    (h : IsPrimitivePythagoreanTriple x y z) (hx : x % 2 = 1) (hz : 0 < z) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ,
      x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ∧
        y = 2 * m * n ∧
          z = m ^ 2 + n ^ 2 ∧
            Int.gcd m n = 1 ∧
              (m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ m

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pythagorean_classification
statement:
theorem pythagorean_classification {x y z : ℤ} :
    IsPythagoreanTriple x y z ↔
      ∃ k m n : ℤ,
        (x = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧ y = k * (2 * m * n) ∨
            x = k * (2 * m * n) ∧ y = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ∧
          (z = k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) ∨ z = -k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2))

statement:
theorem independentRandomVariables_iff
    {Ω E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace F]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → F} :
    X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y ↔ ∀ A : Set E, ∀ B : Set F,
      MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B →

statement:
theorem absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_iff_epsilon_delta (f : ℝ → X) (a b : ℝ) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b ↔
      ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ E,
        E ∈ AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.disjWithin a b →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (E.2 i).1 (E.2 i).2 < δ →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2) < ε

      Tendsto (fun E : ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ × ℝ) =>
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2))
        (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.totalLengthFilter (X := ℝ) ⊓
          𝓟 (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.disjWithin a b)) (𝓝 0)

theorem stieltjesFunction_measure_Ioc {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (a b : ℝ) :
    hf.stieltjesFunction.measure (Ioc a b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Function.rightLim f b - Function.rightLim f a)

statement:

    (hrc : ∀ x, ContinuousWithinAt f (Ici x) x) (a b : ℝ) :
    hf.stieltjesFunction.measure (Ioc a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (f b - f a)

theorem stieltjesFunction_measure_Ioo {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (a b : ℝ) :
    hf.stieltjesFunction.measure (Ioo a b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Function.leftLim f b - Function.rightLim f a)

theorem stieltjesFunction_measure_singleton {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (a : ℝ) :
    hf.stieltjesFunction.measure {a} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Function.rightLim f a - Function.leftLim f a)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.abs_riemannIntegral_le_riemannIntegral_abs
statement:
theorem abs_riemannIntegral_le_riemannIntegral_abs {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    |riemannIntegral f a b| ≤ riemannIntegral (fun x => |f x|) a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegrable_const_lt
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_add
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_add {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => f x + g x) a b =
      riemannIntegral f a b + riemannIntegral g a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_add_adjacent
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    riemannIntegral (fun _ : ℝ => c) a b = c * (b - a)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const_mul
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => c * f x) a b = c * riemannIntegral f a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mean_value
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mean_value {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Set.Icc a b, riemannIntegral f a b = f ξ * (b - a)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mono
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mono {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ g x) :
    riemannIntegral f a b ≤ riemannIntegral g a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_nonneg
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (h0 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ riemannIntegral f a b

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_periodic_one_period
SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_sub {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => f x - g x) a b =
      riemannIntegral f a b - riemannIntegral g a b

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.omegaValue_equations
statement:
theorem omegaValue_equations (left right exponent : HereditaryBaseExpr) (n : ℕ) :
    HereditaryBaseExpr.zero.omegaValue = 0 ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.digit n).omegaValue = n ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.add left right).omegaValue =
        ordinalAdd left.omegaValue right.omegaValue ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.mul left right).omegaValue =
        ordinalMul left.omegaValue right.omegaValue ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.basePow exponent).omegaValue =
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 exponent.omegaValue

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.positiveDigit_goodstein_descent
statement:
theorem positiveDigit_goodstein_descent {base : ℕ}
    (d : PositiveDigitNormalForm base) :
    goodsteinStep base d.expression = d.digit - 1 ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base d.expression ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.omegaValue < d.expression.omegaValue

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.positiveTail_goodstein_descent
statement:
theorem positiveTail_goodstein_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : PositiveTailNoBorrowForm base) :
    goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + (f.digit - 1) ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.basePowerOneTail_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem basePowerOneTail_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression = f.head.eval (base + 1) + base ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.basePowerTwoTail_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem basePowerTwoTail_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + ((base + 1) * base + base) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.fastGrowingApprox_rules
statement:
theorem fastGrowingApprox_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι) (fuel n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a, system.stage a = .zero → fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = n + 1) ∧
    (∀ a previous, system.stage a = .successor previous →
      fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n =
        iterate (fun x => fastGrowingApprox system fuel previous x) (n + 1) n) ∧
    (∀ a sequence, system.stage a = .limit sequence →
      fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n =
        fastGrowingApprox system fuel (sequence n) n)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.fundamentalSystem_legal_rules
statement:
theorem fundamentalSystem_legal_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι)
    (legal : system.Legal) (a : ι) :
    match system.stage a with
    | .zero => True
    | .successor previous => system.below previous a
    | .limit sequence => ∀ n, system.below (sequence n) a

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.hardyApprox_rules
statement:
theorem hardyApprox_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι) (fuel n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a, system.stage a = .zero → hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = n) ∧
    (∀ a previous, system.stage a = .successor previous →
      hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = hardyApprox system fuel previous (n + 1)) ∧
    (∀ a sequence, system.stage a = .limit sequence →
      hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = hardyApprox system fuel (sequence n) n)

theorem cramerRao_lower_bound {ν : Measure 𝓧} {p : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ} {s : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ}
    (h : IsRegularDominatedFamily ν p s) (T : 𝓧 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hswap : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν) θ) :
    (deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ) ^ 2 ≤
      fisherInformation ν p s θ * variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)

    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hswap : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν) θ)
    (hI : 0 < fisherInformation ν p s θ) :
    (deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ) ^ 2 / fisherInformation ν p s θ ≤
      variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)

    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))

theorem exists_contDiffTwo_approx_eqOn_mapsTo_open
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hf : Continuous f) {S V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {U : Set E}
    (hS : IsClosed S) (hV : V ∈ nhdsSet S) (hfV : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hfU : MapsTo f closedUnitSquare U) :
    ∃ g : ℝ × ℝ → E,
      ContDiff ℝ 2 g ∧ EqOn g f S ∧ MapsTo g closedUnitSquare U

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_contDiffTwo_pathHomotopy_of_boundaryCollar
statement:
theorem exists_contDiffTwo_pathHomotopy_of_boundaryCollar
    {x y : E} {p q : Path x y} (F : p.Homotopy q)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, f (z.1, z.2) = F z)
    {V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hV : V ∈ nhdsSet closedUnitSquareBoundary)
    (hfV : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hFU : ∀ s t : unitInterval, F (s, t) ∈ U) :
    ∃ H : p.Homotopy q,
      (∀ s t : unitInterval, H (s, t) ∈ U) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2
        (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Set.IccExtend zero_le_one (H.toHomotopy.extend xy.1) xy.2)
        (Icc 0 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary_standardExtension_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary_standardExtension_contDiffOn
    {x y : E} {p q : Path x y} (F : p.Homotopy q)
    (f g : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (hfF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, f (z.1, z.2) = F z)
    (hgf : EqOn g f closedUnitSquareBoundary) :
    let H := pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary F f g hg.continuous hfF hgf
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2
      (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Set.IccExtend zero_le_one (H.toHomotopy.extend xy.1) xy.2)
      (Icc 0 1)

theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops (x : X) :

      ∃ (U : Set X) (_hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x ∈ U),

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.correctedLoopWord_eq_concat

theorem correctedLoopWord_eq_concat {x₀ : X} {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (q i.castSucc) (q i.succ))
    (connector : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → Path x₀ (q i)) :
    correctedLoopWord q F connector =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦correctedLoop (connector 0) (Path.concat q F)
          (connector (Fin.last n))⟧

    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop middle second right⟧ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop left first middle⟧ =

        ⟦correctedLoop left (first.trans second) right⟧

      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop
        (C.connector i.castSucc)
        (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)

theorem map_reverseDfoldl {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N]
    (φ : M →* N) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → M) :
    φ (Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => M) (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1) =
      Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => N) (fun i acc => φ (a i) * acc) 1

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdge_eq_rightCellEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdge_eq_rightCellEdge

    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label k j) :
    D.horizontalCommonEdgeInPiece i k j hshared hlabel =
      (((squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map
          (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel k j (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).continuous).cast
          ((D.horizontalCommonEdge_source_eq_right i k j hshared hlabel).trans
            (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex k j 0 0
              (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_cast
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_cast {x₀ z w z' w' : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hz : z' = z) (hw : w' = w) :
    Path.correctedLoop (left.cast rfl hz) (segment.cast hz hw) (right.cast rfl hw) =
      Path.correctedLoop left segment right

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_cast_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_cast_proof_irrel {x₀ z w z' w' : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hzLeft hzSegment : z' = z) (hwSegment hwRight : w' = w) :
    Path.correctedLoop (left.cast rfl hzLeft) (segment.cast hzSegment hwSegment)
        (right.cast rfl hwRight) =
      Path.correctedLoop left segment right

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_change_connectors
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_change_connectors {x₀ z w : X}
    (left left' : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right right' : Path x₀ w) :
    (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop right' (Path.refl w) right⟧)⁻¹ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left segment right⟧ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop left' (Path.refl z) left⟧ =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left' segment right'⟧

    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :

      i k j hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of false
        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV false g) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.endChange)⁻¹ *
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.endChange) *
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
            (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0)) *
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.startChange)⁻¹) *
        Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.startChange

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_top_target_eq
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_top_target_eq
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)

    binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i l)
        (⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.succ, by
          simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]
            using D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hshared hswitch 1⟩ :
          ↥(U ∩ V)) =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel i l 1 0 (D.label i l) rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison_relation

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTop_pieceElement_relation

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_rebase_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_rebase_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps)
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topRight topLeft :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    (rebaseEdge bottomLeft topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)))⁻¹ *
      (rebaseEdge topLeft topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)))⁻¹ *
      rebaseEdge bottomRight topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) *
      rebaseEdge bottomLeft bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1

statement:

    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge T.startChange T.endChange
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
statement:
theorem rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (startFrame endFrame edge : Fin n → G)
    (hadj : ∀ (s t : Fin n), s.succ = t.castSucc →
      endFrame s = startFrame t) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct (startFrame ⟨0, hn⟩)
        (List.ofFn fun k => (endFrame k, edge k)) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (List.ofFn fun k =>
          (endFrame k, rebaseEdge (startFrame k) (endFrame k) (edge k)))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod
statement:
theorem reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod
    {G : Type*} [Group G] : ∀ {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → G),
    Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => G) (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1 =
      (List.ofFn a).reverse.prod
  | 0, a => by simp [Fin.dfoldl_zero]
  | n + 1, a => by
      rw [Fin.dfoldl_succ_last]
      rw [List.ofFn_succ']
      change a (Fin.last n) *
          Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => G) (fun i acc => a i.castSucc * acc) 1 = _
      rw [reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod (fun i => a i.castSucc)]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.commonCentralTransition_square_of_label
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.commonCentralTransition_square_of_label
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (b : Bool)
    (hBL : D.label i j = b) (hBR : D.label k j = b)
    (hTL : D.label i l = b) (hTR : D.label k l = b) :
    let HB := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal b hBL hBR
    let VR := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      k j l hVertical b hBR hTR
    let VL := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hVertical b hBL hTL
    let HT := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal b hTL hTR
    let f : FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b) →* binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
      Monoid.PushoutI.of (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) b
    (f VR.startChange)⁻¹ * (f HB.endChange)⁻¹ =
      (f HT.startChange)⁻¹ * (f VL.endChange)⁻¹

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions_end_potential
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions_end_potential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    let T := D.horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_end_potential
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_end_potential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    let CB := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    let CT := D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    let T := D.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CB.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) CT.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralInternalTransitions_square

    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc) :
    let HB := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal
    let VR := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      k j l hVertical
    let VL := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hVertical
    let HT := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_leftEdge

    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    (j : Fin D.steps)

      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)

      j frames hcompat).leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).bottomLeft
        (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ j)

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)

    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k)) :
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFullBoundary_standard_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFullBoundary_standard_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let last : ℕ := D.steps - 1

    (D.gridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast)⁻¹ *
        (D.gridTopBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV)⁻¹ *
        D.gridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast *
        D.gridBottomBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV = 1

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.coe_gridCellRightEdge_eq

    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k))
    (hedges : ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight

theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridBoundaryWordsAt_left_eq_right
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      D.gaugeGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp =
        D.gaugeGridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  | 0, hp =>
      D.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 hp
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_reverseRows
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_reverseRows
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct (List.ofFn fun r : Fin D.steps =>
        let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
        let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
        (1, (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          r frames compat).leftEdge))

statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_leftmost
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat).leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).bottomLeft
        (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
            ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩ 0))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
    let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
    let hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp' i)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic
statement:
theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
      (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) (i : Fin n),
      (Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i).Homotopic (F i)
  | 0, p, F, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | 1, p, F, i => by
      have hi : i = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem
statement:
theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem :
    ∀ {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
      (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
      (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
      (i : Fin n) (S : Set Y),
      (∀ t, F i t ∈ S) → ∀ t, Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i t ∈ S
  | Y, _, 0, p, F, i, S, hF => Fin.elim0 i
  | Y, _, 1, p, F, i, S, hF => by
      have hi : i = 0

      (r : Fin (n + 1)),
      Path.concat p F (pathConcatBreakpoint n r) = p r
  | 0, p, F, r => by
      have hr : r = 0

theorem binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece_homotopic_representative

    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))

    (binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i).Homotopic

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale
statement:
theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
      pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n
  | 0, i => by simp [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator, pathConcatDyadicScale]
  | n + 1, i => by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp
      · rw [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc]
        calc
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n j ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n

    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n),
      pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.castSucc <
        pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.succ
  | 0, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | n + 1, i => by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc, Fin.succ_last,
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last]
        calc
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n (Fin.last n) ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n

statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c d : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)) :
    let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
    let wUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨w, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
        (by simpa using hb 1) (by simpa using hc 1) hne⟩
    let wd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩
    let hw : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d wUV = wd := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV wUV d wd localEnd hw

statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_sharedPotential
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {a v₁ v₂ w : X} (hv : v₁ = v₂)
    {b₁ c₁ b₂ c₂ d : Bool}
    (q₁ : Path a v₁)
    (hb₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c₁) (hne₁ : b₁ ≠ c₁)
    (q₂ : Path v₂ w)
    (hb₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c₂) (hne₂ : b₂ ≠ c₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (hd₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨a, by simpa using hd₁ 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨v₁, by simpa using hd₁ 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localStart₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨v₂, by simpa using hd₂ 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd₂ 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (hlocal :
      let w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨v₁, by simpa using hd₁ 1⟩
      let w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨v₂, by simpa using hd₂ 0⟩
      let hw : w₁ = w₂ := by apply Subtype.ext; exact hv
      localEnd₁.cast rfl hw.symm = localStart₂) :
    let C₁ := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q₁ hb₁ hc₁ hne₁ hd₁ localStart₁ localEnd₁
    let C₂ := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q₂ hb₂ hc₂ hne₂ hd₂ localStart₂ localEnd₂
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C₁.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C₂.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)

    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}

    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
    let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
    let T := D.horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)

    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let C := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
    let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.castSucc, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          D.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i k j hshared hswitch 0⟩

        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =

        hxU hxV hUV z (D.label k j) w C.rightStart hz

statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPath_localElements_pushout_rebase
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (bStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hb 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (bEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hb 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (cStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hc 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c))
    (cEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hc 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c)) :
    let CB := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hb bStart bEnd
    let CC := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hc cStart cEnd
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.rightElement :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.startChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.startChange)
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.endChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.endChange)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.rightElement)

    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hlabel : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) =
      A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t))
    (u : unitInterval) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let C := A.subdivision.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hU hV col lower upper hrows hlabel
    ((C.rightStart u : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label col lower)) : X) =
      ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t u :
          binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (A.subdivision.label col upper)) : X)

      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,

          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩

        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i t 0⟩

      apply Subtype.ext
      exact A.leftBoundary_segmentGridEdgeIndex_shared_vertex i s t hshared

        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s).cast rfl hw.symm =

theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))

      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let verticalT := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * verticalT.startChange

    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hzLeft : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 1)
    (hzRight : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label k j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece k j 0 1) :
    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 1 1 hzLeft)
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k j 0 1 hzRight)

statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.combinedLeftBoundaryFrames_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
    let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
    lowerT.endChange * lowerF.topLeft =
      upperT.startChange * upperF.bottomLeft

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredBlockFrames_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredBlockFrames_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos Li hi)
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hj⟩
    let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
    let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
    let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
    upperF.bottomLeft = vertical.startChange * lowerF.topLeft

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision H U V n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos j
    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos Li hi)).succ =
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hj⟩).castSucc

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
statement:
theorem pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i j : Fin n)

    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk j
    (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i (finLastOfPos Li hi)).succ =
      (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k j ⟨0, hj⟩).castSucc

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockTransitions_cocycle
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockTransitions_cocycle
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    let si := finLastOfPos Li hi
    let sj : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor j) :=
      ⟨0, hj⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i si
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j sj
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i si
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j sj
    let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * vertical.startChange

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
        ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
          A.factor_pos i⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1 (letters.reverse.get i).2)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge_eq_rowLeftEdge
statement:
theorem rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge_eq_rowLeftEdge
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)) :
    let row := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let frames := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt
    let compat := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt
    A.rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s =
      (A.subdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV row frames compat).leftEdge

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseLetterChain
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseLetterChain
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.leftResidualGauge_bottom_eq_top
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.leftResidualGauge_bottom_eq_top
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p (Path.refl x₀)) {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let hbottom := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let htop := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let bottomPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first first 0 0 hbottom
    let topPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first last 0 1 htop
    let bottomFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos first
    let topFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV last.val last.isLt first
    bottomPotential⁻¹ * bottomFrame.bottomLeft =
      topPotential⁻¹ * topFrame.topLeft

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryGlobalCombinedFrames_eq
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryGlobalCombinedFrames_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let firstBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let firstLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos firstBlock
    let firstEdge : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor firstBlock) := ⟨0, firstLengthPos⟩
    let lastBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length :=
      ⟨letters.reverse.length - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let lastLength := pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor lastBlock
    let lastLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos lastBlock
    let lastEdge := finLastOfPos lastLength lastLengthPos
    A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge =
      A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge
